files.app/api/og/lobby/[code]/route.tsx: Route handler returning an ImageResponse. It renders one cached PNG per lobby code for link-preview crawlers (Slack, Discord, iMessage), not for a signed-in viewer, so there is no locale to render in and useTranslation() cannot run outside a component.
files.app/root-document.tsx: The document every root layout renders. The only string is the brand wordmark in the pre-hydration header skeleton, which renders before any locale is known and outside a client component, so useTranslation() cannot run here.
files.lib/site-card.tsx: The site-wide link preview, an ImageResponse served by app/opengraph-image and app/twitter-image. One PNG for the whole site: no viewer and no React component, so there is no locale to pick and no hook to call.
